title: Dual-path temporal map optimization for make-up temporal video grounding

problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: These two candidate sets represent the cross-modal makeup video-text similarity and multi-modal fusion relationship, complementing each other.

problems.name: Long-Video Evidence Sparsity and Efficient Selection
problems.evidence_sentence: Dual-path temporal map optimization for make-up temporal video grounding Make-up temporal video grounding (MTVG) aims to localize the target video segment which is semantically related to a sentence describing a make-up activity, given a long video.

problems.name: Dataset, Benchmark, and Evaluation Mismatch
problems.evidence_sentence: DPTMO extracts both query-agnostic and query-guided features to construct two proposal sets and uses specific evaluation methods for the two sets.

methods.name: Contrastive or Cross-Modal Alignment

methods.name: Transformer/DETR-Style Proposal Decoding
methods.evidence_sentence: Proposal-free methods directly predict the start and end timestamps of the target video segment, while proposal-based methods firstly generate different candidate proposals and then rank them based on the similarity between query and proposal features.

methods.name: Memory, Graph, or Structure Alignment
methods.evidence_sentence: Different from the commonly used single structure in previous methods, our dual-path structure can mine more semantic information in make-up videos and distinguish fine-grained actions well.
